name: PostcardReviews
job: Show reviews as postcards from customers laid on a table, each with a postmark of their town; the tapped card slides to the centre and turns to its message (social proof that shows where customers come from)
visitor_action: tap a postcard to open it; tap again or press Esc to return it; arrow keys cycle
owner_settings: Card colours (border, accent, card stock, ink, table)
mobile: cards stack in a loose pile with each town showing; tap opens the card at full width
motion: card slides to centre and flips with spring, others settle back with a stagger (reduced-motion: card crossfades to its message)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: open card did not move/scale at wide widths, container rule overrode it; pile strip raised so towns show at 375)
checks.craft: pass (3, after 1 polish pass: fade on overflowing messages)

art_direction: Seaside post: faded aqua and coral card borders, cream card stock, blue-black pen script, round postmark ink, matte
